snip.t: Vitamin C deficiency → ↓ collagen hydroxylation → fragile capillaries → petechiae, poor wound healing, scurvy.
Bleeding gums, petechiae, easy bruising: Vitamin C deficiency — Impaired collagen synthesis → fragile capillaries.
Breastfeeding protects against vitamin C deficiency throughout infancy.

Causes include vitamin C deficiency (scurvy), systemic amyloidosis, chronic glucocorticoid use, inherited connective tissue disorders, and infectious/hypersensitivity vasculitides (meningococcaemia, infective endocarditis, rickettsial diseases, typhoid, Henoch-Schönlein purpura).
